text: One colour group from the primary palette, consisting of 1 key colour with its variants, has been selected.
howToTest: Look at buttons, links, highlights and headings. They should all come from ONE colour family (one dark 'key' colour plus its lighter shades) picked from the DBIM primary palette. Use an eyedropper on 5-6 spots and compare the hex codes with the DBIM Toolkit palette.
finding: It was observed that the website uses colours that do not belong to a single DBIM primary-palette colour group. <<list hex codes found and pages>>
impact: Inconsistent look; website does not carry the uniform Government of India digital identity.
recommendation: Select one colour group from the DBIM primary palette and apply its key colour and variants throughout the website.

text: Other colours used (background, cards, etc.) are from the functional palette.
howToTest: Check backgrounds, cards, tables, borders and greys. These must come from the DBIM functional palette (neutral greys, white, status colours). Eyedrop and compare.
finding: Background/card colours outside the DBIM functional palette were observed. <<hex codes, pages>>
impact: Visual inconsistency with DBIM; reduced brand uniformity.
recommendation: Replace non-listed background and card colours with functional-palette colours.

text: Icons used in the platform use either the key colour (darkest shade) from the selected colour group or inclusive white.
howToTest: Look at every icon on the site. Each must be either the darkest shade of your chosen colour group or white. Right-click icon > Inspect and read the fill/colour value.
finding: Icons are rendered in colours other than the key colour or white. <<icons, hex codes>>
impact: Icons look inconsistent and may lose contrast.
recommendation: Recolour icons to the key colour (darkest shade) or inclusive white.

text: Footer background is of the key colour (darkest shade) of the selected colour group.
howToTest: Scroll to the footer. Eyedrop the footer background and compare with the darkest shade of the primary colour group chosen in #1.
finding: Footer background is not the key (darkest) colour of the selected colour group. <<observed hex vs expected>>
impact: Footer does not match DBIM; breaks colour consistency.
recommendation: Set footer background to the key colour of the selected group.

text: Icons follow a consistent icon style.
howToTest: Scan the whole site and compare icons side by side. They should all be the same style (all outline or all filled, same stroke weight, same corner style).
finding: Icons of mixed styles (outline/filled/different stroke) were observed. <<pages>>
recommendation: Use one consistent icon style across the site.

text: Icons have been selected from the icon set provided in the DBIM Toolkit, unless unavailable in the kit.
howToTest: Take the icons on the site and search for the same icon in the DBIM Toolkit icon set. If a matching one exists in the toolkit but the site uses a different one, it is a gap.
finding: Icons not sourced from the DBIM Toolkit although equivalents exist. <<icons>>
impact: Deviation from the standard icon library.
recommendation: Replace with the equivalent DBIM Toolkit icons.

text: Icons are in PNG, SVG or WEBP format only.
howToTest: Right-click an icon > Inspect (or Network tab > filter Img) and read the file extension. Only PNG, SVG or WEBP are allowed (no JPG, GIF, ICO, BMP).
finding: Icons delivered in disallowed formats (<<format>>) were observed.
impact: Non-standard formats may blur or be heavier to load.
recommendation: Convert icons to SVG (preferred), PNG or WEBP.

text: Icon sizes are as defined in DBIM.
howToTest: In DevTools, select an icon and read its rendered width x height. Compare with the icon sizes table in DBIM (Section 3.7).
finding: Icon sizes differ from the sizes defined in DBIM. <<observed px vs expected>>
impact: Uneven visual hierarchy and brand deviation.
recommendation: Resize icons to the DBIM-defined sizes.

text: The correct proportion of the icon is retained and the icon is not compressed or stretched.
howToTest: Compare each icon's displayed size to its natural size (Inspect > hover image shows rendered vs intrinsic size). The width:height ratio must be the same. Squashed or stretched icons look distorted.
finding: Icons are stretched/compressed (rendered ratio differs from intrinsic). <<icons>>
recommendation: Preserve the original aspect ratio (auto height / object-fit: contain).

text: When an icon is placed on an image or a banner, sufficient contrast has been maintained with its background.
howToTest: Find icons placed on banners or photos. Check they are clearly visible; measure contrast between the icon and the image behind it (aim for at least 3:1).
finding: Icons on banner images have insufficient contrast. <<ratio>>
impact: Icons may be unreadable, especially for low-vision users.
recommendation: Add a solid/translucent backing or change icon colour to achieve sufficient contrast.

text: The typeface used is Noto Sans.
howToTest: Right-click body text > Inspect > Computed > 'Rendered Fonts'. It should say Noto Sans. Also check headings, buttons and menus.
finding: Typeface other than Noto Sans (<<font found>>) is used. <<pages>>
impact: Typographic inconsistency; DBIM mandates Noto Sans.
recommendation: Use Noto Sans as the primary typeface across the website (self-host the font).

text: Body text is left-aligned.
howToTest: Read paragraphs of body text; text should start flush left, not centred/justified/right. Check CSS text-align.
finding: Body text is centre/justify aligned. <<pages>>
impact: Harder to read, particularly long text.

text: Capital case is not used for long sentences or paragraphs and does not include Hinglish.
howToTest: Look for sentences or paragraphs written in ALL CAPS, and for Hinglish (Hindi written in English letters). Short labels in caps are fine.
finding: Long sentences in capital case / Hinglish content found. <<text, pages>>
recommendation: Use sentence case and proper English or Hindi (Devanagari).

text: Type scale is as defined in DBIM.
howToTest: Inspect H1-H6, body and caption text and read font-size / line-height. Compare with the DBIM type scale table (Section 4.3.1).
finding: Font sizes do not follow the DBIM type scale. <<element: observed vs expected>>
impact: Weak visual hierarchy; inconsistent with DBIM.
recommendation: Apply the DBIM type scale for headings and body.

text: Text colour is as per DBIM and displays optimal contrast with the background.
howToTest: Check text colour is the DBIM text colour and has enough contrast with its background (normal text 4.5:1, large text 3:1). Run an automated contrast check.
tool: axe DevTools / Colour Contrast Analyzer / Lighthouse
finding: Text/background pairs fail contrast. <<colours, ratio, location>>
impact: Low-vision and colour-blind users cannot read content.
recommendation: Use DBIM text colours with at least WCAG AA contrast.

text: Button sizes are consistent, with uniform padding used throughout.
howToTest: Compare the height, width, padding and font of all similar buttons across pages (Submit, Search, Read more).
finding: Buttons differ in size/padding. <<examples>>
recommendation: Standardise button size and padding per DBIM Section 4.5.

text: Distinct button styles are incorporated to differentiate between button states.
howToTest: For a button/link check the states: normal, hover, focus (press Tab), active, disabled. Each should look visibly different.
finding: Button states are not visually distinct. <<which state>>
impact: Users, especially keyboard users, cannot tell what is active/focused.
recommendation: Define distinct styles for default, hover, focus, active and disabled states.

text: Mouse hover prompts a noticeable change in clickable items.
howToTest: Move the mouse over links, buttons, cards and menu items. There must be a clearly visible change (colour, underline, shadow) and the cursor should become a pointer.
finding: No visible hover change on <<elements>>.
recommendation: Add hover styles on all clickable items.

text: Emblem has been obtained from the authorized source.
howToTest: Compare the emblem file with the official one from the DBIM Toolkit / Government source. Look for a redrawn, fake or low-quality emblem.
finding: Emblem does not appear to be from the authorised source. <<details>>
impact: Misuse of the State Emblem; legal and brand risk.
recommendation: Download and use the emblem only from the authorised source.

text: Emblem is in proper ratio and is not scaled disproportionately.
howToTest: Inspect the emblem: rendered width vs height must match the original ratio. Check it is not squashed or stretched.
finding: Emblem is scaled disproportionately. <<rendered size>>

text: Website naming has been done as per the organization type (e.g., Ministry / Department).
howToTest: Look at the website name in the header. Check it follows the DBIM naming convention for your organisation type (e.g. 'Ministry of ...' / 'Department of ...', Section 5.2).
finding: Website naming does not follow DBIM for the organisation type. <<observed vs expected>>
impact: Wrong or inconsistent identity of the organisation.

text: Logo lockup is either black on a white background or white over a dark background.
howToTest: Look at the logo lockup: it must be black on a white background, or white on a dark background. No coloured or low-contrast lockups.
finding: Logo lockup is neither black-on-white nor white-on-dark. <<detail>>
recommendation: Use the approved lockup variants only.

text: Generic header components (e.g., logo lockup) have been chosen from DBIM based on the type of government organization.
howToTest: Compare the site's header with the DBIM generic header options (Section 5.4) for your organisation type.
finding: Header component does not match the DBIM generic header for this type of organisation. <<gap>>
impact: Not aligned with the Government of India header standard.
recommendation: Adopt the DBIM generic header variant applicable to the organisation.

text: All the subcomponents of the generic header are enabled and accessible on the digital platform.
howToTest: Click/test every header item (search, language switch, accessibility controls, skip to content, login etc. as per DBIM). Each must be visible and working on desktop and mobile widths.
finding: Header sub-components missing/non-functional: <<list>>.
recommendation: Enable all DBIM header subcomponents and make them accessible.

text: Footer displays all the key information elements and lineage as mandated in DBIM.
howToTest: Scroll to the footer. Tick off the mandatory elements (links, contact, policies, last-updated, ownership/lineage statement, social links etc.) as listed in DBIM Section 5.6.
finding: Footer is missing mandatory elements: <<list>>.
impact: Required information is not available to citizens.
recommendation: Add all mandatory footer elements as per DBIM 5.6.

text: Correct / accurate logos have been used.
howToTest: Check each logo (organisation, partner, Digital India, etc.) is the correct and latest official version, not an outdated or redrawn copy.
finding: Incorrect/outdated logo(s) used: <<logo>>.
recommendation: Replace with the official correct logo.

text: Logos are not scaled disproportionately.
howToTest: Inspect each logo: rendered width:height vs natural ratio (same method as #9).
finding: Logo scaled disproportionately: <<logo>>.

text: All logos are in JPEG / JPG, PNG, SVG or WEBP format only.
howToTest: Network tab > Img filter: check the file type of every logo. Only JPEG/JPG, PNG, SVG, WEBP are allowed.
finding: Logo in disallowed format: <<format>>.

text: Logos are less than 100 KB in size.
howToTest: Network tab: read the Size of each logo file. It must be under 100 KB.
finding: Logo size exceeds 100 KB: <<file, size>>.

text: Background images are under 500 KB.
howToTest: Network tab: find CSS/section background images; each must be under 500 KB.
finding: Background images exceed 500 KB: <<file, size>>.
impact: Slow load, especially on mobile data.

text: Banner and header images are under 500 KB.
howToTest: Check hero/banner images at the top of pages: each under 500 KB.
finding: Banner images exceed 500 KB: <<file, size>>.
impact: Slow first paint and poor performance score.

text: Thumbnail images are under 100 KB.
howToTest: Check small card/list thumbnails: each under 100 KB.
finding: Thumbnail images exceed 100 KB: <<file, size>>.

text: High-resolution images are less than 5 MB.
howToTest: Find large/high-resolution images (galleries, downloads). Each must be under 5 MB.
finding: High-resolution images exceed 5 MB: <<file, size>>.

text: All images are in JPEG / JPG, PNG or WEBP format only.
howToTest: Check image formats in the Network tab: only JPEG/JPG, PNG, WEBP (no GIF, BMP, TIFF).
finding: Disallowed image format(s): <<format>>.

text: Thumbnails have been provided for high-resolution images, along with a provision to view or download the high-resolution version.
howToTest: On galleries/high-res images check that a small thumbnail is shown first and there is a link to view/download the full image.
finding: Thumbnails / high-res view option not provided. <<pages>>
recommendation: Provide thumbnails with a view/download link for the high-res version.

text: Images have been used after obtaining necessary permissions and licenses, and do not carry a third-party ownership watermark.
howToTest: Look for visible watermarks (stock sites, news agencies) and check whether image source/credit/licence is available. Reverse-search suspicious images.
finding: Images with third-party watermarks or unclear licensing found. <<images>>
recommendation: Remove such images; use licensed or owned images with credit.

text: Headshot images for individuals used on the website are as defined in DBIM.
howToTest: Check profile photos (Minister, officers): same size, crop, background and style as defined in DBIM 6.1.4.
finding: Headshots do not follow DBIM specifications. <<detail>>

text: All content is complete and up to date.
howToTest: Click through all menus. Look for empty pages, 'coming soon', broken links, old dates/events, outdated names.
tool: Manual + link checker (Screaming Frog / Broken Link Checker)
finding: Incomplete/outdated content observed: <<page>>.
recommendation: Complete and update content; set a review cycle.

text: The language used is free from any spelling or grammatical errors and does not include Hinglish.
howToTest: Copy page text into a grammar/spell checker. Also look for Hinglish.
finding: Spelling/grammar errors or Hinglish found: <<text, page>>.

text: Central Content Publishing System (CCPS) has been integrated.
howToTest: Ask the department whether the Central Content Publishing System (CCPS) is connected; check content is published via CCPS and not only locally.
finding: CCPS integration could not be verified (Pending declaration).
recommendation: Integrate with CCPS as per DBIM 7.4.

text: Clear consent for personalisation is obtained in the user's preferred language.
howToTest: Open the site in a fresh private window; check that a personalisation consent notice appears in the user's chosen language (Hindi/English).
finding: No clear personalisation consent in the user's language.
recommendation: Add clear consent per DBIM 7.6.1 in the preferred language.

text: A cookie consent banner is displayed at the bottom of the page, allowing users to accept, reject or customize their cookie preferences.
howToTest: Open the site in a new private window: a cookie banner should appear at the bottom with Accept, Reject and Customise options. In DevTools > Application check non-essential cookies are not set before consent.
finding: Cookie consent banner missing or lacks Accept/Reject/Customise options.
recommendation: Implement a bottom cookie banner with all three options.

text: Search is working.
howToTest: Type a few words (a scheme name, 'contact', 'tender') in the search box and press Enter. Results must load without error.
finding: Search function is not working / returns an error.

text: Search provides relevant results across all the content of the website.
howToTest: Search for 10 known items (pages, PDFs, news). Check they appear in the first results and are relevant.
finding: Search results are not relevant/complete: <<queries>>.
recommendation: Index the whole site and tune relevance.

text: Relevant metadata, persona-specific tags, and keywords have been provided to improve searchability and categorization.
howToTest: View page source: check title, meta description, keywords and persona tags exist on important pages.
finding: Metadata/keywords/persona tags missing on <<pages>>.
recommendation: Add relevant metadata and persona tags.

text: Website is responsive across multiple screen sizes.
howToTest: Resize the browser to desktop (1440), tablet (768) and mobile (375) or use DevTools device mode. Nothing should overlap, get cut off, or need sideways scrolling.
finding: Layout breaks at <<width>>: <<issue>>.
impact: Mobile users cannot use the website properly.

text: Website content has been presented as per the Ministry / Department-specific information architecture.
howToTest: Compare the menu and page structure against the Ministry/Department information architecture in DBIM Annexure A.1.
finding: Website structure differs from the prescribed information architecture. <<gap>>
impact: Users cannot find the standard sections.

text: Personas relevant to the Ministry / Department have been shortlisted and displayed on the Home Page.
howToTest: Open the Home page and look for persona choices (e.g. Citizen, Business, Government, Media).
finding: Relevant personas are not shown on the Home page.
recommendation: Shortlist and display personas on the Home page.

text: Persona-based navigation displays the content relevant to the selected persona.
howToTest: Click each persona and check that the content shown is relevant to that persona.
finding: Persona navigation shows irrelevant or identical content.

text: Relevant content tagging has been done for the personas.
howToTest: Check that content items carry persona tags (visible in filters or in the CMS).
finding: Content tagging for personas not found.

text: Homepage components are as per DBIM.
howToTest: List the Home page components (banner, PM quote, highlights, services, social etc.) and compare with DBIM A.4.
finding: Home page components differ from DBIM: <<missing>>.

text: Integration with social media handles is in place.
howToTest: Look for social media icons/feeds and click each to confirm it opens the official handle.
finding: Social media integration absent or broken.

text: Image of the Hon'ble PM has a transparent background.
howToTest: Inspect the PM image: it should be a transparent-background PNG/WEBP with no white box around the figure.
finding: PM image does not have a transparent background.
recommendation: Use a cut-out image with transparency.

text: PM image and PM quote are obtained from the authorized sources.
howToTest: Verify the PM photo and quote come from official PMO/PIB sources and the quote is verifiable.
finding: PM image/quote source cannot be confirmed as authorised.
recommendation: Use only authorised image and quote.

text: A PM Quote relevant to the Ministry / Department has been displayed on the Home Page.
howToTest: Read the quote: it should be relevant to the Ministry's/Department's work.
finding: PM quote is missing or not relevant.

text: The PM Quote has been displayed as per the prescribed format in DBIM.
howToTest: Compare layout (image, quote, attribution, colours) to the DBIM prescribed format.
finding: PM quote not in the prescribed format.

text: Objectives and functions of the Ministry / Department are displayed as a list.
howToTest: Open the About Us / Objectives page: objectives and functions should be shown as a list (bullets).
finding: Objectives and functions not displayed as a list.

text: Correct names of Ministers and their portfolios have been used on the 'Our Team' page.
howToTest: Check the Our Team page against the official Ministry website / Government directory for correct names and portfolios.
finding: Incorrect names/portfolios: <<details>>.

text: The correct organization hierarchy has been depicted.
howToTest: Check the organisation chart/hierarchy against the official order.
finding: Hierarchy depicted incorrectly.

text: Names of departments, organizations, attached offices, etc. are correct on the 'Our Organization' page.
howToTest: Check the Our Organization page: names of departments, attached offices, PSUs etc. against the official list.
finding: Incorrect entity names: <<names>>.

text: Name / title of the offering and documents is a maximum of 150 characters.
howToTest: Check titles of offerings/documents; count characters; the maximum is 150.
finding: Titles exceed 150 characters: <<titles>>.

text: The Vacancies page is fully updated.
howToTest: Open the Vacancies page: check closed postings are removed/archived and dates are current.
finding: Vacancies page is outdated.

text: Validation for the Tenders page has been satisfied.
howToTest: Open the Tenders page and validate fields (tender no., dates, document, status, closing date logic) per DBIM A.5.2.3.
finding: Tender page validations not satisfied: <<gap>>.

text: Periodic documents' versioning (with date of release) has been done.
howToTest: Check periodic documents (reports, circulars) show a version and release date.
finding: Documents lack version/release date.
impact: Users cannot tell which is current.

text: Titles of the Documents and Resources section elements are suitable and a maximum of 250 characters.
howToTest: Check titles in Documents and Resources are suitable and at most 250 characters.
finding: Titles exceed 250 characters or are unclear.

text: Videos have appropriate captioning (subtitles) and date.
howToTest: Play videos: subtitles/captions must be available and the release date shown.
finding: Videos without captions/date.

text: Contact details of the CIO, Web Information Manager, Appellate Authority and PIO on the 'Contact Us' page are accurate and up to date.
howToTest: Open Contact Us: verify CIO, Web Information Manager, Appellate Authority and PIO names/phone/email are current. Test email/phone where possible.
finding: Contact details are inaccurate or outdated.

text: Geotagging given on the 'Contact Us' page is correct.
howToTest: Open the map on Contact Us; the pin must match the real office address.
finding: Geotag location is incorrect.

text: All uploaded content is complete and up to date.
howToTest: Same method as Generic #38: check all uploaded content is complete and current.
finding: Incomplete/outdated content.

text: Content accuracy has been ensured through a multi-level workflow in the CMS (at least 2 levels).
howToTest: Ask the department / inspect the CMS: content goes through at least 2 approval levels (maker-checker).
finding: Multi-level workflow not confirmed (Pending).
impact: Risk of wrong content going live.
recommendation: Enable a workflow with 2 or more levels.

text: Appropriate titles (Dr., Shri, Smt., Mr., Ms.) have been used uniformly.
howToTest: Check names across pages: titles Dr., Shri, Smt., Mr., Ms. are used consistently.
finding: Titles used inconsistently.

text: All Documents, Presentations and Brochures are uploaded as accessible PDFs; no editable file format has been used.
howToTest: Check downloads (documents, presentations, brochures): all must be PDFs (not DOC/XLS/PPT) and the PDFs accessible (tagged, selectable text).
tool: Manual / Adobe Acrobat accessibility checker / PAC
finding: Editable formats or inaccessible PDFs found: <<files>>.
impact: Files can be altered; not accessible.

text: The date format follows the style where the day comes before the month.
howToTest: Check dates are DD-MM-YYYY (day before month).
finding: Dates in MM-DD-YYYY or mixed format.

text: External links and website links provided are secure (HTTPS), clearly identifiable and periodically validated.
howToTest: Click all external links; check they use https, open correctly and are clearly marked as external.
finding: Insecure (http) or broken external links: <<links>>.

text: An archival section is included and all outdated content from relevant sections is archived.
howToTest: Look for an Archive section; check old tenders/news have been moved there.
finding: No archive section / outdated content not archived.
recommendation: Create an archive and move old content.

text: Ministerial images and officer listings are arranged by seniority.
howToTest: On Our Team / officer listings check the order follows seniority.
finding: Seniority order not followed.

text: Instructions for filling the form are given at the start of the form.
howToTest: Open each form: instructions should be at the top.
finding: No instructions at the start of form: <<form>>.

text: Forms are keyboard-friendly.
howToTest: Use only the keyboard: Tab through fields, Enter to submit, Shift+Tab back. Focus must be visible.
finding: Form cannot be completed with keyboard only.

text: Mandatory fields are clearly marked with an asterisk (*) or 'Required' along with the label.
howToTest: Look for * or 'Required' beside mandatory fields.
finding: Mandatory fields not marked.

text: Labels are clickable to enable easy selection of the form field.
howToTest: Click a field's label; the cursor should jump into that field.
finding: Labels not linked to fields.
impact: Harder to use, especially on mobile.
